    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    int insert = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        char current = s[i];
        int j = i;

            j++;

        int runLength = j - i;
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            insert++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << insert << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
